body: From the #235 fix verification (ledger on #235): `refresh_channel_symmetry` walks all lanes per drained record, so a dense automation ride (a record on every track every block) pays +51% on a synthetic 8-track probe (8.46 vs 5.60 µs/block); ~20 µs worst-case at 64 tracks. Digest-invisible, needs sustained per-block traffic to matter — non-blocking for launch. Repair shape (verifier's): per-lane refresh in `set_trim_signed` instead of the whole-bank walk. Post-launch item; standard implement→verify protocol.
title: refresh_channel_symmetry is O(records×lanes) under sustained per-block record traffic
